messages:
Maria: Hey team — SolaceChip EAP kickoff. Quick sync: we need NDA alignment, telemetry/telemetry schema, and a bench sweep window. @Kai can you advise on legal timing?

Kai: Saw the draft. Two small asks from legal: add explicit data retention language (30 days) and require KMS encryption for uploaded artifacts. I can push a revised NDA in ~2 hours.

AJ: Hardware side: lab slot confirmed 4/6–4/10 (PST). We'll bring 2x A100-like nodes + partner firmware. Planning perf + mem + soak tests. Need recommended models and a test harness.

Sam: Suggest using the internal small-latency-suite as baseline: https://git.internal/redwood/evals. Proposed run flags: `--batch=1 --seq=1024 --warmup=50 --samples=300`. Capture cold & warm cache.

Lee: Marketplace/partner ops note: we'll need a 60–100 word co-listing blurb + hi-res logos and approved partner quote before we can submit. ETA for that?

Maria: Ideal timeline: internal perf pass -> SI integration -> soft co-list 4/20. But we can move earlier if numbers are strong.

AJ: Telemetry: partner prefers a small opt-in probe. Can we expose `/metrics/solace-eap` with aggregated counters: token_count, tokens_per_sec, gpu_util_pct, p95_ms? Partner wants no raw text.

DevBot: Uploaded file: `drive.redwood.com/solace/eap-checklist-v1.md` (added checklist, telemetry schema stub, bench matrix).

Sam: Important: prefix/KV cache will change results. Capture `--cache=off` (cold) and `--cache=on` (steady). Also log `kv_hit_rate` and `mem_usage_mb`.

AJ: Example run we saw in lab: ```./run_bench --model=redwood-1b --seq=1024 --batch=1 --run=warm``` output: `latency=42ms p50=28ms p95=73ms gpu_util=84%`. Share artifact names: `solace_eap_<date>_warm.json`.

Maria: @Kai — would partner sign off on aggregated telemetry + hashed request ids? We need that called out in NDA.

Kai: Yes, agreeable. I'll add clause: "Only aggregated metrics and cryptographic hashes of request IDs to be shared; no raw prompt/response retention." Also add the 30-day retention and KMS requirement.

Lee: Draft marketplace blurb incoming. I'll aim for a first pass by EOD today with three bullets (latency, throughput, deployment modes).

Maria: Action items recap: (1) Kai to post updated NDA by EOD Wed; (2) AJ+Sam to run initial perf + upload artifacts by 4/8; (3) Lee to prepare marketplace draft by 4/10; (4) Partner to confirm quote/logo during that window. Meeting Thu 9am PT to review results.

AJ: Adding telemetry schema to the checklist now. Will ping when ready. :thumbsup:

Sam: I'll include run scripts and a short runbook for reproducing numbers.

Maria: Thanks all — keeping this thread as single source for EAP ops.
